scope: Native animation color read-back and separation of untinted UObject source from themed Slate presentation
identity: Fresh installed executable hash matched the canonical catalog; newly followed reader windows matched imported bytes.

native_read_path.finding: The LinearColor reader copies the current 16 bytes from the resolved UObject property. Binding resolution caches do not provide a protective untinted RGB copy. Channels have an independently evaluated validity mask.

canvas_separation.finding: Setter independently copies input into UObject and Slate; Slate color retains no pointer to the UObject field. Post-setter untinted property-only write-back does not itself refresh or undo themed Slate.

implementation_contract: Capture genuine incoming source before transformation or consuming ownership transfer.
After themed native setter returns, require current invocation/revision, callback authority and subject identity before writing latest genuine source to documented UObject property only.
LinearColor uses a checked 16-byte write; owning SlateColor uses existing native owning assignment, never memcpy.
Do not invoke the color setter or Slate refresh for source write-back.
Invocation/reentrancy provenance distinguishes genuine updates from adapter calls; do not infer channels from RGB equality or force stock colors.
An outer invocation must not overwrite a newer genuine nested update or forwarded-update invalidation.
Keep direct image-family opacity interception and the full owning Bottom attribute restoration protocol.
limits: Exact blending-cache miss/reuse behavior for the observed live animation was not traced; not every alpha sample is claimed to reread the property.
Previously contaminated initial/preanimated caches cannot be reconstructed from this remedy; manual validation needs a clean untinted baseline.
Setter-internal reentrancy may expose transient themed property values before post-return write-back.
Text setters independently own Slate attributes, but this does not qualify arbitrary custom accessors or unresearched properties.
Bottom property write-back does not clear Slate bottom activation; Original requires the existing complete unset/bound attribute restoration.
Older reader/cache counterparts were not newly qualified; existing older setter contracts remain separately attributed.
No new callable, native invocation, live mutation or visual qualification resulted from this research.
